items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think that Zoot(Sims) is about as black as anybody I know. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I guess so.

ctx.x: I think so, too. Because you see little kids, white, black, any other color, and they can keep time and everything. But in our culture you get inhibited and tied down and you don't hear that kind of music.
In that kind of environment it turns out that way. I think that Zoot(Sims) is about as black as anybody I know.
Yeah, I guess so. Because, you know, it's more comfortable for me to think it's cultural because if it's inherited, I don't have a chance. But there was this undercurrent.
